purpose: Keep character acoustic identity stable while allowing the underlying TTS engine to be replaced or benchmarked.
laws: The adapter may render but may not rewrite character text.
The adapter may not infer unresolved demographic/accent/timbre properties from narrative biography.
The adapter may not silently substitute another character or reference identity.
Reference-conditioned generation requires an authorized provenance record.
An accepted artifact remains pinned to its engine/profile/text/settings identity.
Changing engine version or acoustic profile creates a new candidate artifact rather than mutating an accepted artifact.
Film integration and website streaming are consumers of this contract, not owners of character identity.
cacheKeyLaw: HASH(engineId, engineVersion, characterId, profileVersion, text, deliveryMode, semanticEmphasis, targetDurationMs, referenceBindingId)
